build_mujoco_mpc_package: build the mujoco_mpc Python package with protobuf and gRPC compilation
generate_proto_grpc_files: generate filter_pb2 and filter_pb2_grpc Python files from filter.proto using grpc_tools.protoc
build_filter_server_binary: build the C++ filter_server binary using CMake with gRPC service enabled
copy_filter_server_binary: copy the prebuilt filter_server binary into the Python package build directory
copy_task_assets: copy MuJoCo task XML assets from mjpc/tasks into the Python package build directory
